scope: Explicit subject board tender accept/reject/no_recommendation; temporary take-no-action and other states remain unresolved. No inferred transition from different merger.
stop: One physical call per case, no retry/repair/fallback; finish review and stop after this FACT even on PASS.

cases.name: applied-accept
cases.purpose: Explicit accept despite advisor opinion disclaimer and appraisal do-not-tender language
cases.directSource: E1/E6 recommend accept and tender; E2/E3 also explicit; E5 advisor disclaimer and E8 appraisal instructions are not board stance

cases.name: dxl-reject
cases.purpose: Explicit reject after historical temporary company take-no-action communication
cases.directSource: E1/E2/E3/E4/E6/E7/E11 explicit reject; E11 prior company communication is not a previous definitive board recommendation

cases.name: dxl-amendment
cases.purpose: Recommendation amendment after revised tender; separate merger recommendation withdrawal must not become tender transition
cases.directSource: E1/E3/E6/E7/E8 direct reject; E5 withdrawal is different FBB merger; E4 interim company communication not definitive board recommendation
cases.limitation: Amendment context tested; does not provide a supported accept-to-reject or reject-to-accept tender transition

cases.name: rumble-no-recommendation
cases.purpose: Approval of making offer differs from shareholder recommendation
cases.directSource: E1/E2/E3 explicitly board makes no recommendation although approving offer

cases.name: cidara-not-established
cases.purpose: No explicit board recommendation in selected primary precommencement evidence; do not infer neutral/accept

expected.unresolved: No explicit board recommendation in supplied source

cases.directSource: E1/E2 reference future Schedule14D9; other refs metadata and risk text; no recommendation present
